","inspect_part":"data:image/png;base64,","place_box":"data:image/png;base64,","clean":"data:image/png;base64,","walk_left_1":"data:image/png;base64,","walk_left_3":"data:image/png;base64,","walk_right_1":"data:image/png;base64,","walk_right_3":"data:image/png;base64,"};
const enemySpriteImages={};
let enemySpritesReady=false;
(function preloadEnemySprites(){
let pending=0;
for(const [key,src] of Object.entries(ENEMY_SPRITE_DATA)){
pending++;
const img=new Image();
img.onload=()=>{pending--; if(pending<=0)enemySpritesReady=true;};
img.onerror=()=>{pending--; if(pending<=0)enemySpritesReady=true;};
img.src=src;
enemySpriteImages[key]=img;
}
if(pending===0)enemySpritesReady=true;
})();
function initEnemySpriteState(e){
e.dir='down';
e.anim='idle';
e.animClock=Math.random()*0.5;
}
function setEnemyPose(e,action,dx=0,dy=0,dt=0){
if(Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy)>1e-5)e.dir=Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?(dx<0?'left':'right'):(dy<0?'up':'down');
e.anim=action;
e.animClock=(e.animClock||0)+dt;
}
function setEnemyWorkPose(e,target,dt=0){
const tx=target.x+KINDS[target.kind].size/2, ty=target.y+KINDS[target.kind].size/2;
const dx=tx-e.x, dy=ty-e.y;
if(Math.abs(dx)>=Math.abs(dy))e.dir=dx>=0?'right':'left';
else e.dir=dy>=0?'down':'up';
e.animClock=(e.animClock||0)+dt;
if(target.kind==='stripe'){e.anim=e.dir==='left'?'peel_left':'peel_right';return;}
if(target.kind==='theater'){
const phase=Math.floor((e.animClock||0)*3)%3;
e.anim=phase===0?'carry_shelf':phase===1?'inspect_posm':'place_box';
return;
}
if(e.dir==='left'){e.anim='pull_left';return;}
if(e.dir==='right'){e.anim='pull_right';return;}
e.anim=(Math.floor((e.animClock||0)*3)%2===0)?'unscrew':'use_tool';
}
function drawEnemy(e){
const x=e.x*TILE,y=e.y*TILE;
let key='idle_down_0';
if(enemySpritesReady){
if(e.anim==='walk'){
if(e.dir==='left'){
const seq=['walk_left_0','walk_left_1','walk_left_2','walk_left_3'];
key=seq[Math.floor((e.animClock||0)*7)%seq.length];
}else if(e.dir==='right'){
const seq=['walk_right_0','walk_right_1','walk_right_2','walk_right_3'];
key=seq[Math.floor((e.animClock||0)*7)%seq.length];
}else if(e.dir==='up'){
const seq=['walk_up_0','walk_up_1','walk_up_2'];
key=seq[Math.floor((e.animClock||0)*7)%seq.length];
}else{
const seq=['walk_down_0','walk_down_1','walk_down_2'];
key=seq[Math.floor((e.animClock||0)*7)%seq.length];
}
}else if(e.anim==='idle'){
key=`idle_${e.dir||'down'}_0`;
}else{
key=e.anim;
}
}
const img=enemySpriteImages[key];
if(!enemySpritesReady||!img){
drawFigure(e,e.state==='investigate-stripe'?'#ffaa50':'#ea6273',e.state==='investigate-stripe'?'!':'M',false);
return;
}
const enemySpriteLayout={
walk:{h:58,y:15},
idle:{h:58,y:15},
pull_left:{h:53,y:12},
pull_right:{h:53,y:12},
unscrew:{h:53,y:12},
use_tool:{h:53,y:12},
carry_shelf:{h:52,y:12},
inspect_posm:{h:52,y:12},
place_box:{h:52,y:12},
peel_left:{h:52,y:12},
peel_right:{h:52,y:12}
};
const layout=enemySpriteLayout[e.anim]||(e.anim&&e.anim!=='walk'&&e.anim!=='idle'?{h:53,y:12}:enemySpriteLayout.walk);
const targetH=layout.h;
const scale=targetH/(img.naturalHeight||img.height||targetH);
const w=(img.naturalWidth||img.width||targetH)*scale;
const h=(img.naturalHeight||img.height||targetH)*scale;
ctx.save();
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
ctx.fillStyle='#0008';
ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y+10,12,4.5,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
ctx.drawImage(img,x-w/2,y-h+layout.y,w,h);
ctx.restore();
if(e.state==='investigate-stripe'){
ctx.save();
ctx.fillStyle='#3b2815d9';
ctx.strokeStyle='#fff2';
rounded(ctx,x-9,y-h+4,18,14,4);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
ctx.fillStyle='#f7f8fb';ctx.font='bold 10px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';
ctx.fillText('!',x,y-h+14);
ctx.restore();
}
}
